cohort: The study included 147 eligible cases who underwent Cesarean Section under Spinal Anesthesia at Alzahra hospital, an academic referral center in the north of Iran, between May 2019 and October 2019.
finding: The incidence of PDPH was 6.1%, and early ambulation, the number of dura punctures, and having a history of headache were significantly associated with a higher incidence of PDPH.
mod_finding: Factors related to the Cesarean Section procedure, such as the number of dura punctures during spinal anesthesia and early ambulation post-procedure, were significantly associated with a higher incidence of PDPH.
